description: Channels of a polyphonic signal inverted or switched off by polyphonic gates rather than buttons, in 2HP

params.text: Makes the channel knob follow the input while it is dark, and lets you set the count by hand when pressed
Sets how many channels come out, and is ignored while the module is following the input
Chooses how an inverted channel is flipped: Bip. mirrors it about 0V, Uni. mirrors it about 5V, Gate turns a high into a low and a low into a high
Chooses what switching a channel off means: Val replaces it with the disable value, Excl removes it from the output altogether
Sets the voltage a switched-off channel carries in Val mode, -10V to +10V, and is added to the disable value input when one is patched

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal whose channels are inverted and switched off
The voltages given to channels added beyond what the input has; an empty jack gives them 0V
A high gate on a channel inverts that channel; a monophonic signal here inverts every channel at once
A high gate on a channel switches that channel off; a monophonic signal here switches every channel off at once
The voltages switched-off channels carry in Val mode, added to the disable value knob

outputs.text: Carries the input with the chosen channels inverted and the chosen ones replaced or removed

notes: patching one polyphonic signal to the main input and another to the disable value input, with a gate pattern on the disable input, mixes the two signals channel by channel
in Excl mode a changing number of disabled channels changes the output channel count, which many modules only notice every 256 cycles
menu: Gate mode: non-inverted channels: Pass through, High/low-gate — in Gate invert mode, chooses whether channels that are not inverted keep their voltage or come out as gates
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Gate-high detect-level — sets the voltage at which an incoming gate counts as high, 1V or more unless you change it
Gate-high output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while high, 10V unless you change it
Gate-low output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while low, 0V unless you change it

inputs.2:
high above 1V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V, leaving every channel uninverted; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.3:
high above 1V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V, leaving every channel on; a negative voltage does nothing here.
